versions.changelog:
- Added a new 4K enterprise solution title-bar reference image at assets/titlebar-template/enterprise-solution-titlebar-4k.png.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- No changes to workflows or production rules.

- Enforced single-line, vertically centered title bar requirement for all content pages; multi-line titles are no longer allowed.
- Updated title-bar instructions: titles must fit on one line—shorten the text, reduce font size, or seek user approval if needed.
- Removed the sample file skill-card.md from the repository.
- No other workflow or functionality changes.

Version 1.0.2 of ppt-produce-bycodex introduces a standard for consistent title-bar styling on PPT slides.

- Added a 4K enterprise solution title-bar template PNG and reference documentation for title-bar usage.
- Updated workflow to require confirming the title-bar style before batching, using the new asset as default.
- Sample generation phase now includes 3-5 pages plus title-bar validation.
- Enforced a single, confirmed content-page title-bar system across slides unless user requests otherwise.
- Removed outdated skill-card documentation.

Version 1.0.1

- Added built-in fallback handling for 413/too-large failures, including clear downgrade, retry, and handoff prompt instructions.
- Included a new reference file for too-large handoff templates.
- Removed the skill card documentation file.
- Updated PPTX and generation workflow documentation to reflect explicit handling of oversized requests and handoff procedures.

- Initial release of ppt-produce-bycodex skill for generating and managing enterprise application solution presentations.
- Supports full-page PNG slide creation, repair, and assembly into PPTX decks using imagegen/gpt-image-2 models.
- Enforces flexible, structured workspace and strict intake workflow for consistent output and asset control.
- Includes detailed prompt discipline, visual direction standards, and explicit image/PPTX generation rules.
- Provides local repair guidance and sample scripts for asset quality checking.
